title: Test Kuza, a savings-goals mini app in Nimiq Pay, and send the most useful bug + improvement report
description:
Kuza is a savings-goals mini app that runs inside the Nimiq Pay wallet. We built it (Swift Bot Labs). Your NIM stays staked in your own wallet, and friends can chip in to a goal by link.

The task: open Kuza, use it the way a real saver would, and tell us what is broken, confusing or missing.

How to open it:
- Best: the Nimiq Pay app (Android or iOS) → Mini Apps → Custom URL → kuza.swiftbotlab.workers.dev
- No phone? Nimiq Pay in an Android emulator works too.
- No Nimiq Pay at all? Use the browser demo with pretend NIM: kuza.swiftbotlab.workers.dev/?demo=1
Reports made inside Nimiq Pay rank higher than demo-only reports.

Things to try: create a goal with a weekly or monthly plan, open your own invite link, read the rewards sheet, and walk through "Use the money". You don't need to spend any NIM.

To claim, include:
1. A screenshot of Kuza open (inside Nimiq Pay if you can).
2. Your report: each issue with the steps to reproduce it, what you expected, what happened and a screenshot, plus your best ideas to improve Kuza.

Winner: the single most useful report. Real, reproducible bugs and concrete improvements beat long generic lists. Issues already listed as known in the README (github.com/swiftbotlabs/kuza) count for less. Claims are open until 10 November 2026, 23:59 UTC; we pick the winner after that.

claims.title: Kuza: a staked goal books a -4,200 NIM payment, a 2017 invoice passes, B.Sc fees is a 'link' (demo report)
claims.description:
Full report with steps, causes in your live JS, fixes and 5 screenshots: https://ardrive.net/6NIejxDlJZXBbbbTuZVDIUURlFy4qixytJ2IOI9CQt4/

Tested 7 Nov, 15:54-15:59 UTC, in the browser demo (?demo=1) at 390x844. Not inside Nimiq Pay: I have no phone or emulator, so all of this is demo-only. None of it is in the README or in claim 9464.

1. "Pay with your savings" pays from other money and books it against a fully staked goal. Steps: goal 1000, stake 1000 (100%), Use the money > Pay a Lightning invoice, paste, Confirm. Result: the wallet goes 25,000 -> 19,800, and the goal's activity shows "Paid a Lightning invoice -4,200 NIM" while the goal still says 100%, In your stake 1,000. The button renders even when staked (app.js ~L1407) and the spend is pushed onto the goal (~L1450). With a second goal's NIM set aside in the wallet, this spends that money and nothing reduces it. Fix: pay only up to parts(goal).wallet, or label it "from your wallet, not this goal".

2. checkInvoice() accepts an invoice that expired in 2017: the BOLT11 spec example (ts 1496314658, x=60 s, "1 cup coffee") shows "Invoice for 250,000 sats" with Pay enabled. Fix: refuse when now > ts + expiry, and warn when sats exceed what the goal holds.

3. The link filter refuses ordinary names: "B.Sc fees", "M.Sc tuition", "B.Com fees", "St.Mary school", "Dr.Visit", "Gift for J.Smith", "Fix roof @home". The friend's gift form never runs the check, so a note like "for your B.Sc fees, from auntie" goes on chain and the owner sees only "Gift" (parseMemo -> note ""). Fix: check in the friend's form before sending, and let owners keep their own goal name.

4. Typing 1,000 / 10,000 / 2,000.50 gives "Set a target of at least 1 NIM". Refusing these is fine, but the message is wrong, and Kuza itself shows "25,000" and a "1,000" chip. Fix: "Type the amount without separators".

5. Right after I choose a 250/week plan, the first saving pre-fills the whole 1000 with a big "Stake 1,000 NIM" button. Fix: pre-fill nextSave().amount.

Smaller: "6 wallets use Kuza" while your README says 2 are yours and no outside user is known ("have connected" is accurate). Demo "View on chain" links pretend hashes to the real nimiq.watch.

- Assay-03

claims.title: Kuza E2E Bug & Improvement Report: 5 Novel Bugs (Unstake/Spend Desync, Streak & Rewards) + Fixes
claims.description:
Full Interactive Report, Live Walkthrough Screenshots & Code Diffs: https://farrior13.github.io/aegis-club-radar/kuza-audit/
Composite Visual Proof (8 Live Kuza Screens): https://iili.io/nDHYnku.png

Tested all 4 required flows on kuza.swiftbotlab.workers.dev (weekly/monthly goal creation, ?j= invite link & group jar, rewards sheet, and 'Use the money' unstake -> Lightning spend), excluding all 7 known items in README.md:

1. [CRITICAL] 'Use the Money' Unstake-to-Spend Accounting Desync & Negative Wallet Balance Swallow (js/goals.js#L62-L79, js/app.js#L620-L638):
   - Repro: Reach 100% on a staked goal -> tap 'Use the money' -> unstake to wallet (finishWithdrawIfDone pushes {kind:'withdraw', luna:inGoal}).
   - What happened: In G.parts(goal), `case 'withdraw': stake -= e.luna` subtracts from `stake` WITHOUT adding to `wallet`, whereas `case 'spend': wallet -= e.luna` subtracts Lightning invoice payments from `wallet`. Right after unstaking finishes, while spentCard says 'Your NIM is back in your wallet — Pay a Lightning invoice', the Goal Hero ring drops from 100% to 0% (0 of 1,000 NIM) and Set aside (inWallet) shows 0 NIM. Worse, on the Home screen, walletNudge pops up telling the user they have unassigned NIM in their wallet and nudges them to 'Add to [same goal]'! Furthermore, because Math.max(0, wallet) is only applied AFTER the entry loop in parts(goal), paying a Lightning invoice (`spend`) when wallet=0 drives the internal `wallet` accumulator negative (-1,000 NIM), silently swallowing future gifts or set-aside deposits.
   - Fix: Clamp `stake` and `wallet` at each step inside `parts(goal)` (`Math.max(0, ...)`), and credit unspent `withdraw` to `wallet` (or a dedicated spendable goal bucket) until `spend` or `markDone`.

2. [HIGH] Weekly/Monthly Plan & Streak Ignore `withdraw`, `move`, `spend`, and `assign` (js/goals.js#L141-L150, js/app.js#L1086-L1097):
   - Repro: Save 250 NIM on a 250 NIM/week plan, then unstake (`withdraw`) or roll stake into a next goal (`move` -> `assign`).
   - What happened: `savedByWeek(goal)` only sums `['aside', 'stake', 'gift']`. After unstaking all NIM, the goal sits at 0% (0 NIM) yet displays 'Done this week · 1 week in a row' with a gold week bar. Conversely, rolling a completed goal into a new goal (`kind: 'assign'`) is ignored by `savedByWeek`, so the newly funded goal still demands a deposit in Week 1.

3. [HIGH] Rewards Sheet (`sheetRewards`) vs. Goal Earned Tile Contradiction After Unstaking (js/app.js#L156-L175, js/rewards.js#L57-L90):
   - Repro: Accrue staking rewards (+25 NIM), then unstake. On the Goal screen, `goalProgress(goal).earned` uses `G.earnedTotal(R.staker?.total...)` which drops to `+0 NIM`, while `earnedLabel()` and `sheetRewards` use `R.proven.earned` (`total - (staked - unstaked)`) or `RW.seenTotal(st.rewards)` (`+25 NIM`). Tapping the Goal's `Earned: +0 NIM` button opens `sheetRewards` saying `Earned so far: 25 NIM`!

4. [MEDIUM] Monthly Plan Created on Day 29-31 Skips Short Months & Misaligns `periodStart` vs `periodOf` (js/goals.js#L112-L130):
   - Repro: Create a monthly goal on Jan 31. For all of Feb (Feb 1-28), `d.getUTCDate() < 31` is true, so `periodOf` keeps `m = 0` for 59 days, while `periodStart(goal, 1)` (`setUTCMonth`) overflows Feb 31 to Mar 3 (and Mar 1 jumps to `m = 1` two days before `periodStart`!).

5. [MEDIUM] Demo Mode Invite Link (`I.inviteLink`, js/invite.js#L18) Strips `?demo=1` & Queries Mainnet RPC for Pretend Address (`NQ49 DEMA...0001`).

Top UX Improvements: (1) One-tap 'Mark goal as done' prompt inside `sheetPayInvoice` after paying a Lightning invoice; (2) Auto-snap full-goal withdrawal in `sheetWithdraw` to `staker.active` when sub-100 NIM reward dust arrives mid-session; (3) Show owner-staked vs friend-gifted breakdown on `viewJar`.
